problems:
# Bulgaria — notes

- No police-recorded murder figures by district were found openly. NSI "Правосъдие и престъпност" (https://www.nsi.bg/statistical-data/152):
  - 154/494 "Престъпления, регистрирани от полицията" compares EU countries only, with Bulgaria as a single row (murder 74 in 2023).
  - 160/512 "Престъпления, завършили с осъждане ... по области" and 158/504 split by district but only by Criminal Code chapter ("Престъпления против личността"); there is no murder row.
  - 157/501 (crimes ended with conviction by place of commission, down to municipality) has no offence-type split.
  - The NSI press-release PDFs ("Престъпления, обвиняеми и осъдени лица" 2023, 2025) give murders ended with conviction nationally only (62 in 2023 and 60 in 2025, completed plus attempts).
- What is extracted: NSI health statistics, deaths by assault (ICD-10 X85–Y09), as a rate per 100,000 by sex for the country, 6 statistical regions and 28 districts, 2010–2025. These are rates only; the file gives no counts. The sheets "Total/Male/Female" in the same file are national time series and were not extracted.
- Ministry of Interior (mvr.bg) statistics pages returned 404 at the URLs I tried. The web search budget was used up, so I could not find the MVR monthly bulletins (which may give crimes by ОДМВР district directorate).
